name: Hamlet
message: Of course I'm not well. How could I be? You were there! You saw everything!

name: Marcellus
message: Perhaps you ought to lie down a while.

name: Marcellus
message: Or 'ave a drink. Yeh know, I've a bottle of brandy from the year you were born!

name: Marcellus
message: Prolly turned to shit by now, though.

name: Hamlet
message: Leave me, Marcellus. Your kindness is wasted.

name: Marcellus
message: M'lord, will you not even come to this morning's court?

name: Hamlet
message: I don't think I can face him. Not after what I heard last night.

name: Marcellus
message: But if yeh don't come... won't he be displeased?

name: Marcellus
message: I knew yer father well. He always kept a strong face in times like these.
